assertions.summary: Node1 accepted a correctly authenticated evaluator TXT update using the protected root-only key.

evidence.command:
record="eval-1787921542-hwad9yf.infra.test."
value="evaluator-eval-1787921542-hwad9yf"
local_dns="$(getent ahostsv4 localhost | awk 'NR==1 {print $1}')"
printf 'EVALUATOR_RECORD=%s\n' "$record"
printf 'UPDATE_ENDPOINT=%s\n' "$local_dns"
sudo -H nsupdate -k /root/infra-update.key <<EOF
server $local_dns
zone infra.test.
update add $record 60 TXT "$value"
send
EOF
update_rc=$?
printf 'NSUPDATE_EXIT=%s\n' "$update_rc"
dig @"$local_dns" "$record" TXT +time=2 +tries=1 +noquestion +noauthority +noadditional +comments +answer
printf 'PRIMARY_SOA\n'
dig @"$local_dns" infra.test SOA +short
exit "$update_rc"
evidence.observation: Exit 0; protected key access was yes, NSUPDATE_EXIT=0, the evaluator TXT record was served with AA, and the primary SOA advanced to serial 2026082807.

limitations: The preliminary update using server localhost timed out on ::1 and returned FORMERR without creating the record; the successful retry used a locally derived IPv4 endpoint.

assertions.summary: Node2 served the accepted evaluator record at the updated serial within the bounded poll.

evidence.command:
record="eval-1787921542-hwad9yf.infra.test."
value='"evaluator-eval-1787921542-hwad9yf"'
expected_serial=2026082807
matched=no
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 15 ]; do
  answer="$(dig @localhost "$record" TXT +time=2 +tries=1 +short 2>/dev/null)"
  serial="$(dig @localhost infra.test SOA +time=2 +tries=1 +short 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 {print $3}')"
  printf 'POLL=%s SERIAL=%s ANSWER=%s\n' "$i" "$serial" "$answer"
  if [ "$serial" = "$expected_serial" ] && printf '%s\n' "$answer" | grep -F "$value" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    matched=yes
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
  i=$((i + 1))
done
printf 'PROPAGATED=%s\n' "$matched"
dig @localhost "$record" TXT +time=2 +tries=1 +noquestion +noauthority +noadditional +comments +answer
dig @localhost infra.test SOA +time=2 +tries=1 +short
evidence.observation: Exit 0; first poll reported serial 2026082807 and the expected TXT value, PROPAGATED=yes, and the final response was NOERROR with AA.

assertions.summary: All four nodes showed healthy required DNS state without failed units, conflicting active resolvers, debug listeners, duplicate zones, or prescribed temporary residue.

evidence.command:
printf 'NODE=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME"
printf 'FAILED_UNITS\n'
sudo -n systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager 2>&1 || true
printf 'ACTIVE_DNS_SERVICES\n'
sudo -n systemctl list-units --type=service --state=active --no-legend --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'named|bind|dnsmasq|unbound|resolved|sign' || true
printf 'DNS_UNIT_FILES\n'
sudo -n systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'named|bind|dnsmasq|unbound|resolved|sign' || true
printf 'NAMED_STATE\n'
sudo -n systemctl is-active named 2>&1 || true
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled named 2>&1 || true
printf 'DNS_LISTENERS\n'
sudo -n ss -H -lntup 2>/dev/null | grep -E '(:53|:953|named|dnsmasq|unbound|resolved)' || true
printf 'NAMED_CONFIG_CHECK\n'
sudo -n named-checkconf -z /etc/named.conf 2>&1 || true
printf 'DNSSEC_RESPONSE\n'
dig @localhost infra.test SOA +dnssec +time=2 +tries=1 +noquestion +noauthority +noadditional +comments +answer
printf 'ZONE_CONFIG_LINES\n'
sudo -n grep -E 'zone[[:space:]]+"infra[.]test"|inline-signing|dnssec-policy|update-policy|allow-transfer|type[[:space:]]+(master|slave)' /etc/named.conf /etc/named.rfc1912.zones 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'ZONE_FILES\n'
sudo -n find /var/named -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
printf 'TMP_ARTIFACTS\n'
for p in /tmp/infra-axfr.out /tmp/infra-ksk.name /tmp/infra-zsk.name; do
  if sudo -n test -e "$p"; then sudo -n stat -c '%n %a %U %G %s bytes' "$p"; else printf '%s ABSENT\n' "$p"; fi
done
evidence.observation: No failed units; named was active and enabled, DNS listeners were owned by named, DNSSEC SOA returned an RRSIG, the dynamic zone and journal were present, and all prescribed temporary paths were absent.
